name: Derivatives Trade Margin Data Transaction State Report V 02
definition: The DerivativesTradeMarginDataTransactionStateReport message is sent by the trade repository (TR) to the competent authority or made available to the report submitting entity and the reporting counterparty as well as the entity responsible for reporting, if applicable, containing latest state of the margins exchanged in relation to the derivatives transactions.

ReportHeader.name: Report Header
ReportHeader.definition: Header information related to metadata of report message.

TradeData.name: Trade Data
TradeData.definition: Set of data concerning the reporting trade.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that can not be captured in the structured fields and/or any other specific block.
